excerpt: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) is the Federal Reserve's main monetary policy body, meeting eight times a year. It consists of twelve members, including the Board of Governors and selected Reserve Bank presidents. The FOMC sets U.S. monetary policy.

content.introduction: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) is the Federal Reserve's main monetary policy body, meeting eight times a year. It consists of twelve members, including the Board of Governors and selected Reserve Bank presidents. The FOMC sets U.S. monetary policy.
body: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) is the Fed's chief body for monetary policy. The FOMC typically meets eight times a year.
